question: Will Mbappé score 2+ goals vs AEK Athens on Nov 4, 2026 (reg. time + stoppage only)?

model.prompt_context:

- "Yes": Wins if Kylian Mbappé scores 2 or more goals credited during regulation time and stoppage time (excluding extra time and penalty shootout) in the match between Real Madrid and AEK Athens played strictly after 2026-11-04T09:47:38.832Z and at or before 2026-11-05T01:45:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if Mbappé scores 0 or 1 goal credited during regulation time and stoppage time in that same match, or if the match does not take place within the window.

Clarifications:
- Goals counted are only those officially attributed to Mbappé in the final match record for regulation time (90 minutes) and any added stoppage time; own goals, extra time, and penalty shootout goals are excluded.
